# Kspec Automation Session - Task Work

**Session ID:** `01KJKCGRAVN1BTZ611MX7EK5H3`
**Iteration:** 1 of 30
**Mode:** Automated (no human in the loop)


### Current State

> **Truncated** (104281 bytes). Fetch full data:
> ```
> kspec session start --json
> ```
>
> Summary: `{}`

## Instructions

Run the task-work skill in loop mode:

```
$kspec-task-work loop
```

Loop mode means: no confirmations, auto-resolve decisions, automation-eligible tasks only.

**Normal flow:** Work on a task, create a PR, then stop responding. Ralph continues automatically —
it checks for remaining eligible tasks at the start of each iteration and exits the loop itself when none remain.

**Do NOT call `end-loop` after completing a task.** Simply stop responding.
`end-loop` is a rare escape hatch for when work is stalling across multiple iterations with no progress — not a normal exit path.

```sh
OK Started task: 01KJK9DV

--- Spec Context ---
Implementing: Ralph Subagent Spawning

Ralph can spawn ACP subagents for dedicated tasks (e.g., PR review). Subagents are separate Claude Code processes with focused prompts. Subagents run sequentially (ralph waits for completion).

Acceptance Criteria (13):
  [ac-1]
    Given: ralph needs subagent
    When: spawn initiated
    Then: new ACP process started with dedicated prompt
  [ac-2]
    Given: subagent spawned
    When: prompt provided
    Then: prompt includes task ref, skill to invoke (/pr-review @task), context, and explicit review-only role boundary (never fix code)
  [ac-3]
    Given: subagent running
    When: ralph behavior
    Then: ralph waits for subagent completion before continuing
  [ac-4]
    Given: subagent runs
    When: display
    Then: subagent output rendered same as main agent (single stream)
  [ac-5]
    Given: subagent completes
    When: signaling
    Then: task status change (completed/needs_review) indicates outcome
  [ac-6]
    Given: multiple pending_review tasks
    When: spawning
    Then: processes one at a time sequentially
  [ac-7]
    Given: subagent runs
    When: resource management
    Then: respects ralph's --max-retries and failure limits
  [ac-8]
    Given: ralph iteration begins
    When: ralph checks task statuses
    Then: pending_review tasks detected trigger subagent spawn by ralph (host) before main agent iteration continues
  [ac-9]
    Given: subagent is running
    When: subagent exceeds timeout (default 10 minutes)
    Then: ralph terminates subagent and marks task automation: needs_review with timeout note
  [ac-10]
    Given: subagent prompt is built
    When: context is assembled
    Then: includes compact identity summaries of task details and linked spec (with CLI fetch commands for full data), and current git branch
  [ac-11]
    Given: subagent output is displayed
    When: rendering to terminal
    Then: output includes [REVIEW SUBAGENT] prefix to distinguish from main agent
  [ac-12]
    Given: subagent successfully merges PR
    When: workflow completes
    Then: subagent must complete the task (kspec task complete) before exiting; ralph verifies task is completed after subagent success
  [ac-13]
    Given: subagent completes review with blocking findings
    When: subagent exits
    Then: task transitions to needs_work; worker picks it up in next iteration as fix cycle

Remember: Add test coverage for each AC and mark tests with // AC: @spec-ref ac-N
```

  01KFH76C (1/21/2026 by @claude) [design, spec-model, meta]
    Cross-feature requirement pattern: How to express that core features (search, validate, export) must support all entity types. When new entity type added, should automatically imply tasks for core features. Options: (1) applies_to field on feature specs, (2) trait on entity types like @trait-searchable, (3) validation warning for missing coverage, (4) parent spec that entity types must satisfy. Surfaced when realizing search doesn't cover inbox.

  01KFHJNZ (1/21/2026 by @claude) [dx, tooling, reflection]
    Reverse spec lookup - kspec which <file> or kspec which <file:line> to find specs/ACs that reference or are implemented by a given code path. Useful for bug fixes to quickly discover what specs need updating. Could scan for // AC: annotations and spec_ref links. Instructive, helps find already-instrumented code.

  01KFPDCY (1/23/2026 by @claude) [ci, testing, dx]
    Add cross-platform CI matrix testing - run core functionality tests on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Would catch issues like Unix-specific commands (which, cp -r) before they reach PR review. Consider: matrix strategy in GitHub Actions, platform-specific test skips where needed, focus on CLI commands and daemon lifecycle.

  01KFQ517 (1/23/2026 by @claude) [e2e, testing, reflection]
    E2E tests: Use isolated port range (not 3456) + cross-platform cleanup. Current approach conflicts with existing daemons. Should use high ephemeral port range and improve cleanup mechanism.

  01KFYAHF (1/26/2026 by @claude) [e2e, dx]
    E2E test dev mode - configure Playwright to work with vite dev server instead of requiring full build for faster test iteration (12+ seconds to 1-2 seconds)

  01KGG6GY (3 weeks ago by @claude)
    Improve derive granularity: Research suggests specs with 4+ ACs are candidates for splitting. Potential enhancements: (1) --by-ac flag to create tasks per AC group, (2) --max-acs N to auto-group, (3) implementation_phases field in specs, (4) derive templates for common patterns (cli-command, api-endpoint), (5) complexity warnings when specs are too large. See session research on task decomposition patterns from Linear, Atlassian, BDD/Example Mapping, and AI coding assistants.

  01KGGEMM (3 weeks ago by @claude) [daemon, dx, deferred]
    Daemon debugging improvements: (1) Add --log-file or --verbose to 'kspec serve start', (2) Log resolved web UI path on startup, (3) Capture and show stderr when daemon fails to start within timeout. Consolidated from @01KFQ586, @01KFQ595, @01KFPH3D.

  01KGGF4Y (3 weeks ago by @claude) [feature, config, dx, deferred]
    Project config file (kspec.config.yaml or .kspecrc): Configure shadow remote URL (enable separate repo for specs), feature toggles, default values (author, priority), validation strictness. Enables multi-repo projects sharing specs and tailoring kspec to project needs. Consolidated from @01KFGVVJ, @01KFGVVN.

  01KGGFB2 (3 weeks ago by @claude) [cli, testing, dx]
    AC test coverage analysis: 'kspec coverage @spec-ref' command to scan codebase for '// AC: @spec ac-N' annotations and report which ACs have test coverage vs gaps. Soft check for review, not blocking. Consolidated from @01KFHJNR, @01KFP9A6.

  01KGGG0K (3 weeks ago by @claude) [shadow, dx, cli]
    Shadow sync improvements: (1) Auto-resolve using rebase/merge-driver for cleaner sync, (2) Make sync warnings visible in CLI output (currently silent unless KSPEC_DEBUG=1), (3) Auto-detect common issues with suggested fixes. Consolidated from @01KFTDA7, @01KFHZR4.

  01KGGKNX (3 weeks ago by @claude) [cli, design, dx]
    CLI array field flag patterns: (1) Generic --clear <field> or --<field> [] for clearing arrays, (2) --add-<field> vs multiple flags for append semantics. Design unified approach for depends-on, tags, blocked-by, etc. Consolidated from @01KFGRV6, @01KFR0KN.

  01KGGP9F (3 weeks ago by @claude) [cli, inbox, dx]
    Inbox CLI improvements: (1) Add filtering to list: --before/--after <date>, --author <name> (--tag exists), (2) Add merge command: 'kspec inbox merge @source @target' for consolidating duplicates, (3) Add --priority and --automation flags to promote command. Consolidated from @01KG95JP, @01KG95JQ, @01KG95JS.

  01KGGPJ6 (3 weeks ago by @claude) [workflow, cli, dx]
    Workflow CLI improvements: (1) 'workflow show' should infer active run like 'workflow next', (2) Warn when --input flags passed but step has no inputs defined, (3) Improve 'workflow show' output format with vertical display, status indicators, indented notes. Consolidated from @01KFKSF6, @01KFKSGC, @01KFKTNR.

  01KGGPSR (3 weeks ago by @claude) [cli, validation, ux]
    Spec item slug/addressing improvements: (1) Warn/error on slug collision when creating items, (2) Make nested requirements addressable by slug (currently kspec item ac add @slug fails for items under requirements:). Consolidated from @01KGDCRG, @01KGDCRJ.

  01KGGTT3 (3 weeks ago by @claude) [cli, batch, dx]
    Expand @trait-multi-ref-batch to remaining commands: trait add/remove, task set --automation, inbox delete, task note. Enables batch operations like 'kspec task note @ref1 @ref2 @ref3 "shared content"'. Consolidated from @01KG71J2, @01KG95JM, @01KFVXBM.

  01KGKVK9 (3 weeks ago by @claude) [cli, reflection]
    Add --spec-ref filter to kspec task list command to filter tasks by linked spec item

  01KGQY6Q (3 weeks ago by @claude) [workflow, cli, dx, deferred]
    Workflow lifecycle CLI design (from mining run 01KFS6MJ): kspec workflow complete @run-ref (mark run completed, archive), kspec workflow cancel @run-ref (cancel abandoned run), kspec workflow cleanup --older-than Nd (auto-cancel stale runs).   01KGVK8R (3 weeks ago by @claude) [cli, dx, reflection]
    Item list --module flag and tree view: kspec item list --module cli to scope output to a specific module. kspec item tree @module for hierarchical view (features -> requirements). Currently 50+ items display flat, making it hard to find the right parent for new specs. Friction: during automation triage had to grep YAML files to find parent specs.

  01KGWG99 (3 weeks ago by @claude) [reflection, sessions, schema]
    Define typed event data schemas per EventType — session.start, session.update (with tool_call/sessionUpdate variants), session.end, prompt.sent, tool.call, tool.result, note. Current z.unknown() data field makes it impossible to reliably query events without reverse-engineering from real JSONL files.

  01KGWQ2T (3 weeks ago by @claude) [deferred]

## Instructions

Run the task-work skill in loop mode:

```
$kspec-task-work loop
```

Loop mode means: no confirmations, auto-resolve decisions, automation-eligible tasks only.

**Normal flow:** Work on a task, create a PR, then stop responding. Ralph continues automatically —
it checks for remaining eligible tasks at the start of each iteration and exits the loop itself when none remain.

**Do NOT call `end-loop` after completing a task.** Simply stop responding.
`end-loop` is a rare escape hatch for when work is stalling across multiple iterations with no progress — not a normal exit path.

      "content": "Implementation notes:\n\n## Fix 1: O(1) seq assignment in appendEvent (src/sessions/store.ts)\n\nReplace getEventCount (reads entire file, counts lines) with getLastSeq:\n- Read last ~4KB of events.jsonl (fs.read with position = fileSize - 4096)\n- Find last complete JSON line (last newline boundary)\n- Parse it, extract seq field, return seq + 1\n- Empty/missing file returns 0\n- This is O(1) regardless of file size\n\n## Fix 2: Backpressure in session update logger (src/cli/commands/ralph.ts)\n\nReplace fire-and-forget Promise.resolve().then() pattern in createSessionUpdateLogger with a sequential queue:\n- Maintain a queue of pending updates and a processing flag\n- When an update arrives: push to queue, start processing if not already\n- Process loop: shift from queue, await appendEvent, repeat until queue empty\n- This ensures at most ONE appendEvent is in flight at a time\n- Updates are still non-blocking from the caller's perspective (event handler returns immediately)\n- Queue should be bounded (e.g., 1000 entries) — drop oldest if exceeded with a warning\n\n## Files\n- src/sessions/store.ts — getEventCount → getLastSeq\n- src/cli/commands/ralph.ts — createSessionUpdateLogger backpressure queue\n- tests/sessions-store.test.ts — update seq assignment tests\n- tests/ralph.test.ts — update/add logger backpressure tests",

--- Spec Context ---
Implementing: Ralph command - automated task loop

Automated task loop using ACP protocol. Runs claude-agent-acp agent in a loop to process kspec tasks autonomously with full event logging and streaming output.

Acceptance Criteria (27):
  [ac-1]
    Given: ready tasks exist
    When: kspec ralph is run with --max-loops N
    Then: spawns ACP agent and runs up to N iterations
  [ac-2]
    Given: no ready tasks exist
    When: kspec ralph is run
    Then: command exits with message indicating no ready tasks
  [ac-3]
    Given: a loop iteration starts
    When: agent picks and works on a task
    Then: agent uses task start, task note, and task complete commands per working procedure
  [ac-4]
    Given: a loop iteration ends with work still in progress
    When: agent cannot complete the task in one iteration
    Then: agent commits WIP, adds note documenting progress, and task remains in_progress for next iteration
  [ac-5]
    Given: a loop iteration completes (task done or WIP)
    When: there are uncommitted changes
    Then: agent commits the changes with appropriate message
  [ac-6]
    Given: --dry-run flag is provided
    When: kspec ralph --dry-run is run
    Then: shows the prompt that would be sent without executing agent
```
